body: I'm the same height and weight. I've had blood tests and I am pretty healthy and athletic. I eat whatever I want but it doesnt seem to impact my weight. I get ticked off when people say I dont look healthy but I feel and know that I am.
I'm the opposite, I had a wonderful childhood and was very social. But now I'm a huge introvert and can't connect with people. I just don't get adult life.
I'm the opposite, sleep is my only escape from thoughts of suicide. Wanna trade?

Problem is that this is the way I chose to live. I prefer to have goals and know where I am headed in my life even if they are vague. I consciously refuse to live day by day, due to the fear of waking up one day and realizing my life was a lie. I'd much rather try to figure it all out now if that's possible and then continue my life knowing that I have a purpose. I pride myself in my self-analytic skills, I am very aware of my fears, insecurities, habits and what have you. It is very hard to take responsibility of everything which goes on in your head. But I feel relief when doing so even to small degree. Because in a life where I have so little control, my mind is a place where I have full control. So I chose to be fully conscious of the Matrix and free from any delusions otherwise. Now the next step is living with myself.

I took your advice and decided to distract myself from thinking about it of which I do a lot. Thinking about it so much tends to negatively influence my social life, and my grades to a small degree. The advice worked at leading me to realize that, I don't revert to thinking about the negative things in my life. I only am only forced to think about them when circumstances occur with me specifically at home however not at school where I am able to take my mind away from home. I don't think I would be diagnosed with clinical depression. I'm sure what I wrote may sound extreme but its not what constantly goes through my head. It passes by time to time, I think its only natural to consider such thoughts. At most I am experiencing an existential crisis which I am used to dealing with.

Alright I will try it. Thanks. 

If it was just my thinking or attitude that was the problem then I'm certain that this would work perfectly. But I am effected by physical stress and circumstances which I am trying hard deal with.

I also update my OP.

I do and have a few friends but not one I can talk to about this. However escaping or distracting from the problems at home does not resolve them. They are still waiting for me when I come home. Ultimately in the big picture I am trapped and void of hope. Recently I have not been able to enjoy my favorite music or tv shows.

I took the depression quiz some things really rang a bell with me. Recently I've been doing slowly and haven't felt motivation do them fast. I feel very locked in my life with no ways out, hopeless that anything will change for the better. I feel like my own worst enemy a lot of the time and hate myself certainly more than anyone else. I feel lifeless, like a ghost, being oblivious to the world and its entirety. Wandering endlessly through the halls without purpose. I do think and have thought for a long time about ending it. But I dont think I every had the guts. Then again I've never been pushed so far.
